topics.title: Backtracking Fundamentals
topics.task: Binary Strings: Read N. Generate and print all possible binary strings of length N in lexicographical order, each on a new line.

topics.title: Permutations & Combinations
topics.task: Read a string of distinct uppercase letters (e.g., 'ABC'). Use backtracking to generate all permutations of the string. Print them space-separated in any order.

testCases.expectedOutput: ABC ACB BAC BCA CAB CBA

topics.title: N-Queens Problem
topics.task: Read an integer N. Calculate the total number of distinct valid ways to place N queens on an N x N chessboard safely. Print the integer count.

topics.title: Maze and Subset Problems
topics.task: Subset Sum: Read N and Target. Then read N space-separated integers. Print 'True' if a subset adds up exactly to Target, else 'False'.
